description: Built 8 January 1976; delivered 12 January 1976; registered 22 January 1976 as CCCP-87498 to the Kazakh Civil Aviation Directorate at Ust-Kamenogorsk; passed to Kazakhstan 1992 as UN-87498; flown by Irtysh-Avia and later Air Kazakhstan; installed 2011 in Metallurg park; year_built from the registry's exact build date
